channel.title: MassPermits Research
channel.description: Original analysis of Massachusetts building-permit records. Every figure recomputed from the live data, with the method published alongside.

item.title: What 72 Massachusetts towns publish in their permit records
item.description: Every one of the 72 Massachusetts municipal sources behind MassPermits, what each publishes, and what it does not - 47 publish no project value and 8 publish coordinates.

item.title: Methodology - how MassPermits measures Massachusetts permit data
item.description: How MassPermits collects Massachusetts building-permit records, how work is classified, what is deliberately withheld, and the four rules every research page on this site follows.

item.title: Corrections and rejected analyses
item.description: Corrections and rejected analyses. Every figure MassPermits computed, verified and then declined to publish, with the reason it did not survive.

item.title: What permit follows what in Massachusetts, and how long after
item.description: Across 13,704 Massachusetts addresses that filed more than one trade, 14 pairs of trades run reliably one way. A kitchen/bath permit is followed by gas 84% of the time, a median 26 days later.

item.title: Friday is the quietest day in Massachusetts permit records - and in one town it does not exist
item.description: Across 76,527 Massachusetts building permits from 72 municipal sources, Friday accounts for 12.9% of dated records against roughly 22.9% on Tuesday. In Hingham it is zero.

item.title: We found 315 accessory-dwelling-unit permits in Massachusetts records - and the apparent boom is not real
item.description: 315 ADU permits across 33 Massachusetts towns. Raw monthly counts climb from 4 to 65, but normalized against the same sources the rate is flat. 20.0% mention a garage.
